@slug: con_man
@category: RMFRP Character Law
@default_cost: 31
@description:
 [Vocational] The lure of quick money often draws street urchins into the
 realm of the Con Man. The Con Man is adept at setting people up to rip them
 off. He often has several identities that he can assume (and proper papers to
 back up the identities). Time to Acquire: 32 months. Starting Money: normal +
 d10 (open-ended).
